posts.text: This is a pretty cool benchmark of actual long-horizon tasks, with Fable 5.2 spending more than 200M tokens to try to solve each problem!
posts.quoted: Agents can write code. Can they finish real engineering work? Introducing OWE-Bench, a new frontier coding benchmark: 26 long-horizon engineering projects designed by Mercor experts to test AI agents on engineering work, from GPU kernels to aircraft design. Built by @jake_cole1
